scope: Read-only source audit of alpha9.14 baseline; no full terrain-frequency runtime measurement; subsequent fixes tracked separately.

forest_weight.legacy_target: BiomeManager WARM and COOL weighted biome lists
forest_weight.port_target: TerraBlender OVERWORLD Region weight; replace FOREST/BIRCH_FOREST/OLD_GROWTH_BIRCH_FOREST only
forest_weight.equivalence: Not directly equivalent; no claim of equal biome area or one-third of all land.
forest_weight.action: Do not lower blindly; compare sampled multi-seed biome areas in a separate validation

ordinary_forest_attempt_odds.meaning: Selection odds before terrain/block validation, with support factor 1. Both versions have the same nominal gates.

remaining_findings.effect: Missing trees in overlapping cold/coniferous/forest tags, not evidence of excess
remaining_findings.legacy: BiomeHandler.getBiomeSupportsGreatwood skips unsupported types; COLD is not a veto.
remaining_findings.port: BiomeAffinity.of returns greatwood=0 for cold before testing taiga or forest.
remaining_findings.note: Actual affected biomes require loaded tag memberships; original ordering of multiple supported types is also not deterministic.

remaining_findings.legacy: generateSilverwood permits non-MagicalForest MAGICAL biomes and vanilla IDs 18/28 even after the support chance fails.
remaining_findings.port: Alpha9.14 only uses support factor / 2 and excludes its own magical forest.
remaining_findings.note: IDs 18/28 are obsolete terrain biomes; a modern mapping must be chosen explicitly.

remaining_findings.legacy: Biome top block SAND and temperature > 1; WorldGenCustomFlowers makes 18 attempts.
remaining_findings.port: Any sand ground and 10 attempts; no temperature gate.

remaining_findings.example: At oreDensityPercent=1: original 0 ore attempts; port 1.

remaining_findings.legacy: maxCrystals=round(64*density); cc+=amt (1..3); stop after the complete 3×3×3 cluster when cc>max.
remaining_findings.port: Fixed cap 64; units+=size+1 (2..4); stop in the middle of a cluster when units>=64.
remaining_findings.effect: Different cluster budget, especially with a nondefault oreDensityPercent; unrelated to tree frequency.

remaining_findings.legacy: Cinnabar at Y=0..50, quartz at Y=0..63 in height 256.
remaining_findings.port: Includes minimum build height and deepslate; retains legacy upper limits.
remaining_findings.effect: The same attempt count is spread across a larger height interval; local density is not 1:1.

remaining_findings.legacy: Independent 1/100 chunk gate plus original terrain checks.
remaining_findings.port: Random spread with spacing=10 and separation=4, plus a restricted biome tag.
remaining_findings.effect: Both have a nominal 1/100-cell average, but spatial distribution, spacing and allowed biomes differ.

remaining_findings.legacy: After a failed 1/100 mound roll, an additional 1/500 roll; position at chunk center ±4.
remaining_findings.port: Independent 1/500 gate, fixed chunk center, 3×3×3 air clearance.
remaining_findings.effect: Different placement and acceptance conditions; unrelated to trees.

remaining_findings.legacy: Decorators place beyond chunk boundaries; no candidate biome gate.
remaining_findings.port: The forest branch is selected by chunk center; no candidate biome gate.
remaining_findings.action: Do not add a per-cell biome filter while claiming it restores original behavior.

remaining_findings.legacy: Rare trees use getTopSolidOrLiquidBlock; ordinary biome decoration uses getHeight.
remaining_findings.effect: Leaf/water handling differs. Final tree count cannot be derived from selection gates alone.
